# fixtures/simulator — provenance (GENERATED by scripts/export-simulator-fixtures.ts; do not edit)

The offline MIP-0018 corpus of `acedward/mip-0018-midnight-contracts` on the **UC-1 layout** (spec 00024; an amendment in development of `mip-0018:token-metadata[v1]`: 2-byte little-endian `val-len` at offset 66, value from offset 68, one declaration per package, packages of 256·k bytes under the Multi-Part Event rule). Produced by running the **generated MIP-18 contracts** (`LSUN18` … `LLIAR18`, the ones `scripts/deploy-and-publish.ts` deploys) in the Compact simulator, one `deployments/generated-matrix.json` step per circuit call, and the negative corpus from `contracts/probe/MetadataProbe.compact`.

Regenerate: `npm run export:fixtures:simulator` — deterministic: two runs from the same inputs give identical bytes (compare with the output hashes below).

## Toolchain

| Piece | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Compact compiler (`compact compile +0.34.0`) | `0.34.0` (language `0.26.0`, runtime `0.19.0`) |
| `@midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime` (the simulator) | `0.19.0` |
| Emitter secret of the corpus (a public TEST value, never a real secret) | 32 × 0x42; constructor argument `97ae9211dd0d4e532f6e494ecd75323cd2bbe1f5346df4d5c8446ddf34d11386` |

## Contents

| File | What |
| --- | --- |
| `events.json` | `events`: all 86 `mip-0018:token-metadata[v1]` Misc events as a chain delivers them (256 bytes each; `eventId` = emission order, `packageId`, `part` 1..k, `txStandIn`, `segmentStandIn`). `packages`: the 82 packages they form — 79 × 1 part, 2 × 2 parts, 1 × 3 parts — each ONE declaration: `eventIds` in order, the merged `payloadHex` (256·k bytes, every byte kept), `payloadSha256` and the decoded fields |
| `expected-tokens.json` | the 17 token rows over 17 identities `(contractAddress, domainSep, kind)` a consumer folds out of the packages (last write wins in emission order, a package positioned by its first part — derivation P1): 4 declared, 11 described, 2 observed; traits carry `parts`, and a JSON-object `metadata` is also projected |
| `mints.json` | 16 mint effects a scanner reads out of the transcripts |
| `color-vectors.json` | 15 `(domainSep, address) → colour` vectors, each checked against the contract's own `tokenColor()` |
| `negative-payloads.json` | 40 packages that are not simply applied (2 ignored, 17 rejected, 21 applied), one per rule and on both sides where a rule has two — including the UC-1 cases: a declared length beyond the package (1, 2 and 3 parts), a package filled exactly, a UTF-8 character across a part boundary, a JSON value cut by `val-len`, non-zero bytes after the value (1 and 2 parts) and two declarations merged by one intent (spec 00024 Q11). Every entry has `parts` and its `partPayloadsHex` |

Stand-ins (the simulator has no chain): contract addresses are `sha256("umbra:00024:<row id>")`; `txStandIn` is `sha256("umbra:00024:sim:<row>:<step>")` — one transaction per circuit call; `segmentStandIn` is `1` (one call = one intent; a real chain assigns a random 16-bit segment id). No block heights and no indexer event ids.
